content.user_title: Audit Story Continuity and Plot Logic
content.value_statement: Long drafts make continuity errors hard to spot. This skill checks timelines, character knowledge, plot threads, world rules, POV, and pacing.
actual_capabilities: Builds timeline, character action, plot thread, and world rule trackers from supplied story material.
Identifies timeline contradictions, impossible travel, seasonal errors, and event order problems.
Checks character motivations, knowledge, locations, skills, descriptions, and consequences for continuity issues.
Flags point-of-view violations, including head-hopping and impossible narrator knowledge.
Produces a structured report with severity, evidence, impact, suggested fixes, and priority repairs.
limitations: Requires the user to provide the chapters, synopsis, character list, and world rules to review.
Cannot verify continuity details that are missing from the supplied material.
May miss subtle contradictions in very long manuscripts unless the user provides focused sections.
Provides editorial guidance, but the author decides which inconsistencies are intentional.

use_cases.title: Revise a Novel Draft
use_cases.description: Check a multi-chapter manuscript for timeline breaks, dangling plot threads, and character continuity errors before revision.

use_cases.title: Prepare Editorial Notes
use_cases.description: Create a structured consistency report with evidence, impact, and fix options for an author or writing team.

use_cases.title: Validate Story Worlds
use_cases.description: Track world rules, locations, abilities, and narrative consequences across scripts, game quests, or serialized fiction.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Continuity Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a short excerpt or chapter set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check these chapters for plot consistency. Focus on timeline order, character actions, and any details that contradict earlier scenes.

prompt_templates.title: Timeline and Character Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review when the author can provide supporting notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my synopsis, character list, timeline, and chapters to build trackers. Identify timeline errors, character knowledge issues, and unresolved plot threads.

prompt_templates.title: POV and Pacing Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of narration rules and story rhythm.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript section for POV violations and pacing problems. Note impossible knowledge, head-hopping, rushed events, and scenes that slow momentum.

prompt_templates.title: Full Consistency Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Comprehensive manuscript audit before major revision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full plot consistency report for this draft. Include severity, evidence, impact, suggested fixes, timeline visualization, unresolved threads, and top priority repairs.

output_examples.input: Five fantasy chapters where a hero travels between two distant cities overnight.
output: Flags the overnight journey as a critical timeline issue because earlier text established a five-day distance.
Suggests adding a time skip, establishing magical transport, or revising the stated distance.
Lists the affected chapters and explains how the contradiction affects reader trust.

output_examples.input: A first-person romance scene where the narrator reports another character's private thoughts.
output: Identifies a POV violation because the narrator cannot know another character's memories as fact.
Recommends rewriting the moment as observation, inference, dialogue, or later discovery.
Keeps the emotional purpose of the scene while preserving first-person limits.

output_examples.input: A serialized mystery with several clues, suspects, and unresolved side threads.
output: Creates a plot thread summary showing which clues are introduced, developed, resolved, or dangling.
Ranks unresolved threads by reader expectation and recommends whether to resolve, remove, or reinforce them.

best_practices: Provide a synopsis, character list, timeline, world rules, and the exact chapters to analyze.
Mark intentional mysteries, unreliable narration, time loops, or planned contradictions before review.
Use the priority fixes first, then review moderate and minor issues during later revision passes.
anti_patterns: Submitting isolated scenes without context and expecting reliable continuity judgments.
Treating every flagged contradiction as an error when some may be intentional setup.
Requesting only a consistency score without evidence, locations, and repair suggestions.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks timeline logic, character continuity, plot holes, world rules, POV consistency, unresolved threads, and pacing issues.

faq.question: Does it need my whole manuscript?
faq.answer: A complete manuscript gives the best results, but focused chapters can work when you include enough story context.

faq.question: Can it help with intentional contradictions?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell it which contradictions are intentional, and it can separate planned mystery from accidental continuity errors.

faq.question: Can it rewrite my story?
faq.answer: The skill focuses on analysis and suggested fixes. It can guide revision, but it is not a full rewriting system.

faq.question: How specific are the findings?
faq.answer: The report asks for chapter, paragraph, or scene references and explains the evidence behind each issue.

faq.question: Does it work for screenplays or games?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide scene summaries, scripts, quests, timelines, character notes, and world rules.
